The company demonstrates exceptional profitability with a gross margin of 83% and an operating margin of 48%, alongside massive scale ($17.6 billion in quarterly revenue). However, the relatively high proportion of total liabilities ($91.1 billion) to shareholders' equity ($23.8 billion) introduces some leverage risk, constraining the rating to the lower-to-mid tiers of the strong investment-grade category.

DECISION: A-
